name: WireWorld adder: 2 + 3
description: A two-bit binary adder computing 2 + 3 = 5 (101). Inputs: the four loops on the left are the bits A0, B0, A1, B1 (top to bottom); a loop with a circling electron is a 1 and sends an electron down its wire every 16 generations. The circuit is three crossing-free half adders built from fan-outs, XOR and OR junctions, plus an OR for the carry. Outputs: the three wires on the right are S0, S1, S2 (1s, 2s, 4s); after about 218 generations, the wires of the 1 bits carry an electron every 16 generations. Other inputs: `jetcarp demo wireworld-adder --a A --b B`.
